description: Canonical runtime base-image lock for the Course Factory P5 Terminal Engine. Single source of truth for the immutable guest runtime identity: builds must reference the pinned digest and never a moving tag. Contains deterministic identity only - no machine paths, no timestamps, no usernames.

runtime.node_version_note: Recorded separately per design: the guest patch need not equal the host version. Values are evidence records, not live probes.

policy.runtime_image_id: The locally built runtime image ID is content-addressed per build; it is recorded in phase evidence, never here, to keep this lock deterministic.

provenance.resolved_by: P5.0 Docker isolation prerequisite (docker pull --platform linux/amd64 node:24-bookworm-slim; digest verified against the local image Id)
